Audited PR #11 (the 'deployed' build this entry describes below) directly: raw_dealer_floorplan_feed and raw_credit_bureau_pull were tagged legacy_system_boundary: homegrown_scheduler_owned in metadata only -- both were entries in the same fabric_workspace assets_by_item_name mapping table as every other asset, executed identically via the mocked Fabric trigger/poll API.
